name: Forge
description: Clay from riverbanks and savanna, thrown into moulds on a pottery table and fired hard in a furnace. A forging furnace melts raw metal over coal and pours it into the mould waiting in its basin: an ingot, a plate, or a tool head you lash to two sticks. With the forge installed, metal tools are CAST, never assembled from ingots.
summary: Cast metal tools: clay, moulds, and a forging furnace.
